verdict.rationale: The open-source TruffleHog scanner runs entirely in the user's own environment via brew or Docker and is AGPL-licensed. Truffle Security's getting-started docs also offer an explicit choice between hosted scanners and self-hosted scanners 'running in your environment.' Missing for 10: in-depth self-hosted deployment documentation for the enterprise scanner and web UI (requirements, architecture, upgrades), and hands-on corroboration of an enterprise self-hosted deployment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Choose hosted (managed by Truffle Security) or self-hosted (running in your environment).
Deploy hosted or self-hosted scanners, scan your critical systems for secrets, and notify the right teams to remediate and rotate.
Note that v3 shifts to AGPL, from GPL in prior versions.
